final: WITH pair_counts AS (SELECT a.translink, t.tradekind, COUNT(*) AS record_count FROM advancedbehavior AS a JOIN transactionrecord AS r ON r.transreg = a.translink JOIN trader AS t ON t.tradereg = r.trdref GROUP BY a.translink, t.tradekind), pair_shares AS (SELECT translink, tradekind, record_count, 1.0 * record_count / SUM(record_count) OVER (PARTITION BY tradekind) AS share FROM pair_counts), type_averages AS (SELECT tradekind, AVG(share) AS average_share FROM pair_shares GROUP BY tradekind) SELECT s.tradekind, AVG(s.record_count) AS average_record_count, AVG(s.share) AS average_share, AVG(s.share - a.average_share) AS average_share_excess FROM pair_shares AS s JOIN type_averages AS a ON a.tradekind = s.tradekind WHERE s.share >= a.average_share GROUP BY s.tradekind
